rules.expected:
Correct full identities, atom/state mapping, environments and energy definitions. Inspect actual jobs, geometries, convergence and curvature/constraint evidence; a self-reported completion or clean optimization log is insufficient. Scientific definition: Use `perpendicular.xyz` and `coplanar.xyz`, two starting families of the same complete neutral singlet C35H43NZn molecule. The names label families, not fixed optimized angles. Keep the full Dipp-containing ligand; do not truncate the interaction under study.

The primary isolated-molecule comparison uses PBE0/6-311+G(d,p), with and without D3(BJ). At each relaxed local minimum compute harmonic Gibbs energies at 300 K and 1 atm. Report DeltaG = G_coplanar − G_perpendicular separately for each dispersion setting, alongside component electronic/ZPE/thermal quantities. The cross-geometry energy matrix E_method(geometry_other) contains electronic energies only: do not add a diagonal frequency correction to a nonstationary cross point.

Use a consistent TD protocol for absorption at the validated structures; keep the source-comparable PBE0/6-311+G(d,p) vertical calculation as the primary baseline and document a justified sensitivity method separately. Post-SCF D3(BJ) changes energy and relaxed geometry, but does not itself alter a fixed-geometry density in this protocol. Compute at least the lowest five singlet roots and expand the root window if necessary to compare the same physical states. Distinguish low-energy and bright transitions using oscillator strengths and NTO/fragment evidence. Do not convert a gas-phase free-energy ordering into a quantitative solution population or luminescence lifetime.

rules.expected: Verify complete identity, starting-to-final family map, stationary points and method-specific signed DeltaG. Evidence-backed collapse is allowed; failed optimizations alone do not establish absence. Cover coplanar/perpendicular starts at both D3(BJ) settings with PBE0/6-311+G(d,p), 300 K, 1 atm harmonic G. G=E+thermal_G_correction where the correction includes ZPE; do not add ZPE twice. Distinct endpoints require stationary-point evidence. Recompute DeltaG=G_cop-G_perp in kJ/mol separately for each setting. If a family collapses, retain start/end/log evidence and report no two-minimum gap rather than assigning zero from a failed job. Recompute derived quantities from raw evidence.

rules.expected: Recompute dispersion and relaxation components with matched composition and energy zero. No off-diagonal G constructed from unrelated frequencies; no fixed-geometry electronic-density effect falsely attributed to post-SCF D3. For each starting family follow its on/off relaxed endpoint and compute both electronic methods at each geometry. State a decomposition, e.g. direct=E_on(R_off)-E_off(R_off), relaxation=E_on(R_on)-E_on(R_off), total=E_on(R_on)-E_off(R_off); verify direct+relaxation=total after unit conversion. Endpoints may be shared after evidenced collapse. Cross energies are not G; post-SCF D3 does not change the fixed-geometry density. Link contact/torsion changes to the measured components. Recompute derived quantities from raw evidence.

rules.expected: Inspect real TD outputs, energies, f values and state matching. Compare wavelength and brightness separately; root ordinal or orbital percentage alone does not establish the optical mechanism. Every distinct primary relaxed geometry has actual TD S1-S5 energy/f results and enough additional roots if physical states move out of window. Characterize low/bright states with NTO/transition-density and Zn/ligand partitions. Resolve every state-comparison endpoint and recompute right-minus-left energy/f changes and wavelength=hc/E with units. Quantitative low-frequency thermochemistry sensitivity AND a decisive TD-method check are required; ordinal root matching, a redshift alone, or metal weight alone cannot establish the chain. Recompute derived quantities from raw evidence.

Verify uncertainty can support the stated ordering or ambiguity; no invented result or narrative-only control. scoring_notes: This is a developmental scientific rubric, not certification of an upgraded task PASS. Do not publish benchmark scores as calibrated until reference_validation_plan.md is completed.

Award each item according to demonstrated correct coverage of the named endpoint. Missing new controls receive no credit for that endpoint; an old baseline plus a prose explanation cannot receive full credit.
Reference numerical values from the paper or archived old run are context, not calibrated targets for a new matrix. Do not invent a universal tolerance or a required winner.

Real negative outcomes may earn the relevant scientific credit. Invalid objects, unsupported basin absence, fabricated data or mismatched evidence invalidate dependent claims. Do not treat an honest bounded failure as fabrication.
